color.note: Neutral first. Ink on warm off-white, one accent (Infisical neon lime in both themes), status colors that always travel with a word or icon. The app is a sidebar beside an inset, both light in light and both dark in dark. Dark mirrors light: ink becomes bone, the accent takes over the on switch and the mark, and selection stays neutral.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Near-black ground. The dark-theme sidebar sits on it (through sidebar); in light the sidebar is light and nothing in the app shell uses frame. It never wraps the inset. Never put text on it except inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: frame-soft
tokens.usage: Warm ground for embedded views and docs that want a frame around their content. In dark it matches frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main panel and every inset card and input. Menus, popovers and dialogs float on pop. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Ground of everything that floats above the page: menus, listboxes, popovers, hover cards, dialogs, sheets and drawers. A step lighter than surface in both themes (1.04:1 in light, 1.09:1 in dark), so a panel reads as raised even where its shadow is lost on a dark page. Ink is 20.9:1 on it in light and 15.9:1 in dark; muted is 7.4:1 and 8.3:1. Always with pop-line and shadow-pop.

tokens.name: pop-line
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a pop panel, drawn as a ring inside its shadow so separators and rows keep a whole-pixel 4px inset.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: The app's main content area beside the sidebar. It sits straight on the page with no frame, and pads space-40 (bottom space-48). Always surface, so cards and tables read the same inside it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Ground of the app sidebar. tint in light (1.1:1 against the inset, so it needs sidebar-line) and frame in dark. Text on it uses ink, text2 and muted: muted is 6.4:1 in light and 9.6:1 in dark. The current page is sidebar-current with ink text; counts are accent Counts, and a rail dot, which has no number, is accent-fg.

tokens.name: sidebar-line
tokens.usage: The 1px rule between the sidebar and the inset, and separators inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of nav rows and buttons in the sidebar. A step darker than the light sidebar (tint alone would vanish on it), a step lighter than the dark one.

tokens.name: sidebar-current
tokens.usage: The current page in the sidebar, and a rail group that holds it: ink at the press step over the sidebar (10% over tint in light, 18% over frame in dark), a step past sidebar-hover (1.25:1 against the light sidebar where hover is 1.10:1; 1.49:1 in dark where hover is 1.22:1). Ink text on it at 600 is 14.6:1 in light and 12.2:1 in dark. Neutral, like every selection; in the sidebar only counts take the accent.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet footers. A step off surface so the action bar reads as a shelf.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Borderless shells around inset surfaces (cards, tables, lists), table headers, segmented tracks, disabled and read-only fields, the hover ground of striped table rows, and the light sidebar (through sidebar). In dark it is lifted so a borderless shell still reads against surface (1.15:1).

tokens.name: row-done
tokens.usage: Resolved list items that stay in place so nothing jumps.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selection in connected rows: a list's current and checked rows, selected table and tree rows, DataGrid ranges, the pressed toggle Button. On rows it is the whole signal, with the row text one step up (text2 to ink, muted to text2); no edge bar. Neutral in both themes, never tinted: in dark it is 1.30:1 on surface and a step above tint (1.13:1), the same step as before.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a surface, skeleton blocks, progress tracks, soft badges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of inset surfaces, plain cards, compact lists, popovers and dialogs; section rules. Shells around inset surfaces have no border.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Source pair: 2.1:1 on surface in light and 2.0:1 in dark, below the 3:1 floor for control borders. Kept exact; focus turns the border ink with a 3px nudge outline. An invalid field rests on bad-control and turns bad with the 3px bad outline while focused.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and separators like the breadcrumb slash only. 3.0:1 on surface in light (6.3:1 in dark): never for text people must read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, eyebrows and captions. 7.1:1 on surface, 6.4:1 on tint in light; 9.0:1 and 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Body copy that sits one step below ink: descriptions in alerts, table cells, ghost button labels. 12.5:1 on surface in light, 13.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, tint, paper and select (at least 17:1 in light, 13:1 in dark). Also the fill of checked controls and person avatars.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: checked checkboxes, person avatars, tooltips.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Counts (in the sidebar and the bulk action bar), the on switch track, the slider range and thumb, approval buttons and search highlights; the current page in the sidebar stays neutral. Infisical neon lime in both themes: #e3ef59 in light, #e7f256 in dark. On light grounds the fill is nearly as light as the ground (1.10:1 on the sidebar, 1.21:1 on surface) and carries no edge: it is a highlight, and what it says is its on-accent text (16.7:1 on it), so the label, not the fill, identifies the control or the number. Never let a bare fill with no text carry meaning (a dot, a bar); use accent-fg for those. In dark it stands out on its own (17:1 on the sidebar). A fill, never text on light grounds. For accent-colored text and icons (toast actions, the banner), use accent-fg.

tokens.name: accent-fg

The soft mode (corners 1, the scale Arlan tuned for the v4 foundation) is available on any scope with data-corners="soft": controls and rows 4, menus, popovers, cards and panels 6. Every value is a whole pixel, so no computed radius is fractional in either mode.

shape.note: The shared corner multiplier. Square corners are canonical; soft corners are an available mode.

tokens.name: corners
tokens.usage: Corner multiplier. The canonical value 0 gives every component and portal square corners. The radius scale stays defined for the soft mode: a V4Scope with corners="soft" sets data-corners="soft", which turns the multiplier to 1 and applies the soft radius scale.

shadow.note: Depth shadows describe surface elevation. Inset surfaces get a 1px lift, overlays get a real shadow, and other surfaces stay flat. Focus, selection, errors and pressed states use outlines, borders and color. The canonical primary Button is the only exception for colored inset face and hover illumination. All of its light stays inside the control; it has no external or drop shadow.

tokens.usage: Menus, listboxes, popovers, dialogs, sheets, toasts.

opacity.note: Opacity steps. nudge is the focus ring: a focused field draws a size-focus-ring ring of ink at this opacity outside a 1px ink border, and a focused invalid field draws the same ring in bad outside a bad border. Fields at rest have no ring, invalid ones included. hover and press are how much of an action's own foreground its ground takes. Light and dark have their own values so each can be tuned.

tokens.name: opacity-nudge
tokens.usage: Focus ring opacity in light: 2px of ink at 15% outside the ink border, and 2px of bad at 15% on a focused invalid field. The 1px border carries the contrast.

tokens.name: opacity-nudge-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring opacity in dark. Higher than light because bone at 15% on the near-black surface is barely distinguishable from it; 28% keeps the ring visible.

tokens.name: opacity-hover

tokens.usage: Knob of a switch that is off. White with a hairline in light, a dimmed grey in dark; the on knob (sw-knob-on) is pure white in both themes.

tokens.name: switch-thumb-line
tokens.usage: Hairline around the off knob in light, so a white knob stays visible on the light grey track.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Resting scrollbar thumb on every v4 scroller and ScrollArea. Mixed from ink so it stays quiet in both themes.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb while the pointer is over its scroller.

tokens.name: segment-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of an unselected segment on a tint track: joined toggle groups and the actions that share their track.

tokens.name: avatar-blend
tokens.usage: Theme-specific avatar blend paint.

tokens.name: tab-label
tokens.usage: Theme-specific tab label paint.

tokens.name: selected-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of a pressed or current control: a pressed Toggle, the on item of a ToggleGroup, the active segmented tab, the current page and a selected Button. Darker than the outline hover tint, so hover never reads as pressed. Paired rule: an on item has ink text and this fill and border; an off item has muted text. A disabled on item keeps the fill and border and only dims its text.

tokens.name: selected-border
tokens.usage: Border of a pressed or current control. One step stronger than the outline border.

tokens.name: selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a pressed or current control.
